verdict.line: You lose this if you trade next to walls and let her tentacle passive heal through every poke; you win it once your anti-heal core is online and you start punishing every Harsh Lesson commitment with W (Path Maker).

brief.thesis: Illaoi's passive spawns Tentacles on nearby walls that heal her whenever they hit a champion, so any extended trade fought near terrain quietly flips in her favor regardless of who's ahead on paper. K'Sante's answer isn't more damage, it's denial: fight in open lane, rush the anti-heal pieces in his core build, and treat her W (Harsh Lesson) — a 4s-cooldown leap with no built-in escape — as the exploitable gap in her kit.

theirWindow.when: when you fight her near a wall
theirWindow.what: Nearby Tentacles swing at you and heal her on every hit while she spams Harsh Lesson on its flat 4s cooldown, letting her win extended trades for free — disengage toward open lane instead of slugging it out next to terrain.

yourWindow.when: the instant she leaps in with W
yourWindow.what: Harsh Lesson has no gap closer behind it, so the moment she commits it you can charge W (Path Maker) to stun and knock her back, then chain Q (Ntofo Strikes) for damage she can't answer or retreat from for a full 4 seconds.

powerCurve.note: Her W live before your kit comes online
W and R unlocked, trades even again
Q maxed, anti-heal core swings lane yours
Vessel snowball and tentacles favor her sieges

start.why: The extra healthpool and potion charges let you absorb repeated Harsh Lesson pokes without resetting, since her W is only a 4s cooldown and will hit you over and over in any extended exchange.

boots.why: Every one of her sources of damage — W, Tentacles, autos — is physical, so flat armor directly undercuts her entire trading and sustain package.

core.why: Rushing the anti-heal precursor first starts cancelling the tentacle-and-passive healing that lets her win extended trades, while also giving early tank stats to survive her W spam.
The slow-on-hit zone layers on top of your Q's line slow to keep her locked inside your own trade range instead of hers, and the cooldown reduction brings W (Path Maker) and E (Footwork) back faster.
Stacking resistances carry you through the extended sieges and skirmishes where her tentacle army and vessels keep landing repeated instances of damage.
Completing grievous wounds here punishes her sustain for good and reflects damage on every Harsh Lesson she throws at you.

situational.when: if her team stacks hard CC or heavy magic damage over pure physical pressure
if you need more lane sustain and earlier grievous wounds uptime before Thornmail finishes
if the fight is a grindy siege where your own sustain matters more than reflect damage

runes.keystoneWhy: Autoing her during the slow, grindy trades this matchup produces stacks sustained healing and bonus max-health damage, directly offsetting the tentacle and passive sustain she generates for free.

summoners.why: Ignite punishes exactly the window this matchup is built around: the moment her W is down and you've stunned her with Path Maker, Ignite denies any tentacle-passive healing comeback and secures the kill before she can retreat to a wall.

playing.title: Fight away from walls
playing.detail: Her passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain that heal her whenever they hit you, so pulling fights into open lane denies that sustain outright.

playing.title: Punish her W commitment
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson is a 4s-cooldown leap with no escape attached, so the instant she uses it to poke you, charge W (Path Maker) to stun and knock her back, then follow with Q for a free trade.

playing.title: Respect Test of Spirit's leash
playing.detail: If she rips your spirit out with E, don't walk far enough away to become a Vessel and spawn more tentacles — staying close enough to deny the vessel proc beats fighting a Vessel outright.

playing.title: Stack Q before all-inning
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes grants a stack on hit and fires a pulling shockwave at 2 stacks on a flat 3.5s cooldown, so land two quick Q's before committing to R (All Out) so she can't kite the engage.

playing.title: Rush Bramble Vest for anti-heal
playing.detail: Your build path leads straight into Thornmail off a first-item Bramble Vest, which directly cancels the tentacle and passive healing that lets Illaoi win extended trades.

playing.title: Use E to dodge, not to trade
playing.detail: Footwork stays at rank 1 for most of laning under this skill order, so save its shield and dash for escaping a leap-into-W combo rather than trying to all-in with it early.

playing.title: Save R for her all-in, not yours
playing.detail: All Out's long cooldown and your reduced defenses while transformed mean you want to trigger it when you're already winning a punish window, not as the opener into her tentacle sustain.

brief.patchCaveat: The win rates, item path, runes, and skill order here are pulled from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning about tentacle sustain, the Harsh Lesson punish window, and the Test of Spirit vessel leash is my own read, not something the raw stats state directly.
